title: Preferred language of Text Extractor not remembered
summary: The issue has a repeatable sequence showing that the selected Text Extractor language is used temporarily but is not retained after leaving settings or restarting. The only obvious related issue, #29331, requests automatic selection based on the input language rather than fixing persistence, and the maintainer explicitly acknowledged that the wrong duplicate was closed.

status.label: Design queued
status.detail: Approve a focused Text Extractor design investigation for persistence and settings/UI state synchronization, keeping #29331 as related but distinct.

judgment.rationale: The issue has a repeatable sequence showing that the selected Text Extractor language is used temporarily but is not retained after leaving settings or restarting. The only obvious related issue, #29331, requests automatic selection based on the input language rather than fixing persistence, and the maintainer explicitly acknowledged that the wrong duplicate was closed.
evidence: The body gives a six-step reproduction covering selection, use, leaving settings, reopening settings, and reset.
A triage comment reports that the language-change event is logged by OCROverlay.xaml.cs::LanguagesComboBox_SelectionChanged.
The author supplied a PowerToys bug report ZIP and system context.
Issue #29331 is an enhancement for selecting the input language automatically, not the same persistence failure.
